svg.text: Covered terrace · Layout R2 · presentation plan
Tajik & Uzbek national cuisine · 254 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Đà Nẵng
street stair, plaza under the chinar
patterned paving to the hall doors
tree kept, bench around it, roof oculus
from parking, step-free to the hall
shelving, POS, water, ice, dish drop
Cook aisle 1.1–1.6 m · hood + stack above the roof
Extinguisher + blanket · gas shut-off · floor drain
Glass screen to guests · non-slip slate floor
Base: as-built DWG (Long House, 10-07-2024), measured 1:1. Origin = axis 6 × axis A'. Terrace floor −0.470, platform and hall ±0.000.
Roof: steel trusses on the building grid, supported by columns hidden in the street planters and a ledger on the façade columns (engineer to confirm).
No columns inside the dining. Two trees are kept and grow through roof oculi Ø2.8. The driveway ramp and street planters are kept.
Booths face the sea over the planter. Carved panjara screens h 2.1 m, lanterns over each table, suzani and ikat textiles.
One D–E door stays closed (tables in front). The D–E north door and the back door by the lift open onto the platform.
Concept for client review · dimensions to verify on site
